parameters.value: 4 inch Mild Steel/Stainless Steel wheels (to be specified by user) with ball bearings and axle with lubrication point, The track shouls be 25mm toughned Mild Steel and Stainless Steel (to be specified by user) bar mounted on top of a 4 inch wide Mild Steel and Stainless Steel (to be specified by user) plate of adequate strength

The complete system should be sustainable for smooth operation of the gate, It should have non reversing System by an electric brake to prevent movement of sliding leaves whem the motor is stopped, The gate sliding rail must be linear and horizontal

It should be ideal for fast operation and continuous duty, It Should have reversible gear motor with electric brake, There should be slot holes and height adjustment pins for adjusting position of the motor, The Motor should have adequate covering for all weather protection, In the event of power failure,it should be possible to move the gate manually and the manual release device can be activated from the outside of the motor without removing the cover, Rack of galvanized steel as per the length of gate, Operation of gate through push button and remote, Photocell should be provided for the safety of the vehicle/pedestrain during the operation of the gate

parameters.parameter: Manufacturer should have ISO certification for quality standards
Availability Of Test Report From Central Govt/Nabl/Ilac Accredited Lab To Prove Conformity To Specification
